attr.title: OpenTennis
attr.desc: A fan remaster of Hot Shots Tennis (PS2, 2007): the original's AI, physics, shots and timing, on today's screens, with online play and character mods. Plays from your own disc image.
attr.inst: Put your Hot Shots Tennis (USA) ISO (SCUS-97610, an .iso, not a .chd) in ports/opentennis/. The first start imports it (once); the ISO can go afterwards.
